question: Should Control UI add a per-click Markdown/plain-text copy menu for assistant messages, or should this be a persisted default copy-format preference?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the user-facing UX and conversion contract are product choices rather than a strict bug repair.

options.title: Add Per-Click Format Menu
options.body: Keep the current Markdown behavior as one menu choice and add a plain-text choice without creating persisted settings surface.

options.title: Add Persisted Copy Preference
options.body: Let users choose a default copy format, but require settings/i18n/test coverage and upgrade-safe preference behavior.

options.title: Keep Markdown-Only Copy
options.body: Close or leave low-priority if maintainers do not want another chat action affordance.

recommendation.title: Add Per-Click Format Menu
recommendation.body: Keep the current Markdown behavior as one menu choice and add a plain-text choice without creating persisted settings surface.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the current copy-as-markdown behavior and has recent Control UI work in this area.
